exposure: Immediate post-partum intrauterine contraceptive device (PPIUCD) insertion
cohort: Adult antenatal care (ANC) women admitted to hospital wards or labour rooms who delivered during the 18-month study period, from whom 1155 agreed to PPIUCD insertion and 500 reported for follow-up.
finding: Immediate PPIUCD is a safe and effective method of contraception with a high retention rate.
mod_finding: PPIUCD was inserted post-placental after normal vaginal delivery in 48.32% of patients and after LSCS (Lower Segment Caesarean Section) in 40% of patients.
